_comment: Reactions Tominari posts instead of a headline when a page puts out a birthday wish, a sponsor plug or festival filler. Keys match utils/postClassifier KINDS. `openers` are picked per post, `closers` are appended about half the time. Roman Nepali on purpose — this is banter for the server, not a news desk. Keep it teasing, never actually mean.

birthday: Chyaa, kunchai ko janmadin pathyo. Ma banda ko khabar kurirathe, yo ta cake ko photo raichha.
Oe! Malai lagyo bhaneko chakka jam bhayo ki bhanera... birthday wish raichha. Dhoka.
Happy birthday hai ta, tara maile yo page follow gareko banda ko lagi ho, HBD ko lagi hoina.
Kasko birthday ho thaha chhaina, tara timro notification kharcha bhayo. Sorry gang.
Yo manche ko janmadin le mero din banayena. Feed ma keh news aau na yaar.
sponsored: Chyaa, paisa aayo raichha. News hoina, sponsor ko gungaan ho yo.
Sponsored post! Matlab aaja ko sacho khabar ko rate kati parcha hola?
Oe yo ta bigyapan ho ni. Maile scroll gareko khabar ko lagi, brand ko lagi hoina.
Paid partnership rey. Timro pocket bharyo, mero feed bigriyo.
Brand ko naam padhera nai thaha bhayo — yo post ma khabar chhaina, budget matra chha.
promo: Chyaa, discount ko kura pathyo. Ma banda kaile khulcha bhanera basirathe.
Offer, coupon, hurry up... bhai ma news app ho, shopping app hoina.
Giveaway rey! Jitne ta arkai hunchha, kharcha hune ta hamro data ho.
Yo post ma ek euta pani kaam ko kura chhaina, tara emoji ta pura chha.
Download now, book now, order now — oe ma ta 'khabar now' khojirathe.
greeting: Shubhakamana ta thik chha, tara yo news feed ho ki greeting card ko dukan?
Chyaa, festival wish pathyo. Ramro chha, tara mero kaam ko chhaina.
Sabai lai shubhakamana! Ani ahile khabar kata bata liune ta?
Yo wish padhera petsa bhariyena, khabar padhera bharincha.
Namaste, shubhakamana, dhanyabaad — teen ota word ma pura post sakiyo.
engagement: Chyaa, 'tag a friend' rey. Sathi lai tag garera banda khulchha ra?
Like, share, comment... bhai algorithm khana khoji rahecha.
Yo post ko matlab khoji rahe, matlab bhetiyena. Reach matra bhetiyo.
Bait post detect bhayo. Ma ta bait ma pardina, tara post ta halchhu.
Question mark le sakiyo post. Uttar chahi mero timeline ma khali thau.

closers: Blablabla. Next post ma news hos bhanne aasha.
Yo post ko lagi timro attention barbad bhayo — sorry, mero galti haina.
Feed ma keh kaam ko aayo bhane malai thaha huncha, tension nagara.
Yesto post haru ko lagi mero paisa liudina hai.
